:::{#lem-poisson-zero-rb}
#### Conditional probability of a zero given the Poisson sum

For $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$ and $S \eqdef \sumin \Rvar_\iobs$,

$$
\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0 \given S = t} = \paren{\frac{n-1}{n}}^t
$$ {#eq-poisson-zero-conditional}

for every $t = 0, 1, 2, \ldots$.
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-poisson-zero-conditional.

:::
